question: Is leptin involved in phagocytic NADPH oxidase overactivity in obesity?
reference_answer: Yes. These findings show that phagocytic NADPH oxidase activity is increased in obesity and is related to preclinical atherosclerosis in this condition. We also suggest that hyperleptinemia may contribute to phagocytic NADPH oxidase overactivity in obesity.
